title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. This article reports the live paper record as it stands, with no projection. One trade says nothing about a strategy. The purpose is to state what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.

## Open positions and closed trades

htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper. It has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper. It has 6 closed trades so far, with an average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper. It has 7 closed trades so far, with an average -13.34% net per trade.

The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. At the snapshot, each engine named above shows 0 positions open on paper.

These counts and averages are measurements from a short live window. They are not forecasts, and they do not establish a long-run result. The ATOM trade is one closed trade, and one trade says nothing about a strategy. The NEAR entry being open since 12 October 2026 is a recorded state, not a statement about future movement. Paper framing means these are simulated entries and exits; no real orders are placed anywhere in this record.

## Market filter and breakout distance

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. Both engines show 0 positions open on paper at the snapshot. No position is open in either trend engine at that read.

The recorded distances to 20-day breakout levels are as follows. For trend-daily-v005, TRXUSDT is 12.91% below its high, AVAXUSDT is 21.13% below its high, and XLMUSDT is 21.40% below its high. For trend-daily-v006, JUPUSDT is 12.39% below its high, TRXUSDT is 12.91% below its high, and AVAXUSDT is 21.13% below its high.

These distances describe how far the named symbols are from their highs in the recorded snapshot. A symbol being 12.91% below its high is a measured distance, not a signal. The filter state and the position count are recorded conditions; the percentages are recorded distances. They do not imply that a breakout will or will not occur. The market filter being off is recorded for both trend engines, and the distances below highs are current gaps rather than targets.

## Live starts and testing expectation

v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026. v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. The first live signal came after those starts: an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close.

In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. That expectation is a description of the tested distribution, not a claim about this live window. The tested figure of roughly +19% for the average winner describes past testing, not this live record. The live record now contains closed trades with negative averages for the trend engines and a null average for htf-rsi-v007.

The live start dates are part of the record and are not predictions. The ATOM exit below the 10-day low is a rule-based exit measurement. The NEAR entry remaining open is also a recorded state. The average of -13.22% is over 6 closed trades, the average of -13.34% is over 7 closed trades, and the null average is over 4 closed trades.

## Where the record updates

The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-15T03:09:11.516Z. The record updates continuously, so the numbers can change after that time. Because the record updates continuously, a later read can show different counts, averages, or distances. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The signal log and performance page are the same record viewed in different places, and the channel status is another view of the same numbers.
